description: The Trace object contains information about the distributed trace that produced this event.

uid.description: The W3C trace ID as a 32-character lowercase hexadecimal string.

span.description: The Span object contains information about a span within a distributed trace.

span_id.description: The W3C span ID as a 16-character lowercase hexadecimal string.

start_time.description: The span start time as Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

end_time.description: The span end time as Unix timestamp in milliseconds.
